text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day, a fan letter arrived for Biko Pegasus.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Ah! I actually remember
this kid!

text_block_list.name: Boys
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, what are we doing next!?" "How about kick the can!?"
"We did that yesterday!" "Let's play soccer!"
"Yeah, let's do it!" "Do we have a ball!?"

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Hey, what's up?
Aren't you gonna play with us~?

text_block_list.name: Boy A
text_block_list.text:
"...Because there's no way a shrimp like me
would ever be let in..."

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, don't say that!
Being a shrimp doesn't matter, all you need is guts!

text_block_list.name: Boy A
text_block_list.text:
There's no way I could have courage...!
I'm so small... and I don't have any confidence...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
...Got it!
Then you'd better come watch my next race!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: And so, I'll prove it to you—even if your body is small, you can still have courage!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
She sent me fan mail... Hehe.
I wonder what she wrote—

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
“—I saw your race.
You were so cool! Even though you're small,
you didn't lose to any of the big ones!”

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
"Plus, it gave me courage!
Courage to do my best too! And thanks to that,
I was able to become friends with everyone back then!"

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
"Thank you, Biko Pegasus-san!
You're my hero!"

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
choice_data_list: This is such a heartwarming letter.
This is such a heartwarming letter.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, I'm all fired up now!
Justice Biko, reactivating right here, right now!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Having taken another step closer to his beloved hero, Biko Pegasus felt a fiery passion burning in his heart.
